stories.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
stories.body: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

stories.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
stories.body: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.

stories.title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
stories.body: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the significant test.

stories.title: Pope Leo rides in helicopter cockpit during Peru trip
stories.body: The Pope took to the skies before arriving in Cusco on the penultimate day of his Latin America tour.

stories.title: 'Steering casualty' preceded New Orleans cruise ship collision, says NTSB
stories.body: Preliminary findings by National Transportation Safety Board investigators suggest the tanker suffered a steering failure before colliding with the cruise ship on Friday.

stories.title: Czechs rally against plan to switch funding of public media
stories.body: Protesters say the move will stifle media freedom, while the government insists broadcasters need to cut costs.

stories.title: Police ban protests near 10 schools and five universities in Paris
stories.body: The order will be in place from 16 to 20 November, Paris police chief Patrice Faure says.

stories.title: Three men sentenced to death in Jordan over fatal church mass shooting
stories.body: The attack on funeral at a Greek Orthodox church killed nine and injured 34 others last month.

stories.title: Clothing factories shut in Bangladesh as workers strike over pay
stories.body: Workers are striking over demands for a minimum wage of 30,000 taka (£182) a month.

stories.title: Thousands of US flights still cancelled or delayed two days after grounding of planes nationwide
stories.body: The US transport secretary says that normal air-traffic operations may not be restored until Monday.

stories.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
stories.body: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump closure of 'Trash Island' Washington DC golf course on Sunday
stories.body: The temporary order is part of a months-long challenge to the US president's plans to upgrade East Potomac Golf Links into a championship course.

stories.title: 'Can you believe it?': SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
stories.body: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

stories.title: Watch: Cruise ship overturns after collision with tanker in New Orleans
stories.body: Around 130 people were rescued from a cruise ship after it was struck by a tanker while docked in New Orleans, Louisiana on Friday.

stories.title: Watch: Divers explore US ship sunk off Florida coast to create new reef
stories.body: The ship was intentionally sunk off the coast of Florida in order to create the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

stories.title: Judo champion shakes up French presidential race with surprise candidacy
stories.body: Teddy Riner is one of the most popular figures in modern-day France, and one in five voters say they could support him.

stories.title: My mother told me I would die if I sought treatment for Ebola - I am proof you can survive
stories.body: Fear and misinformation surrounds the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo - Dr Kamwanga's mother was not immune.

stories.title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos
stories.body: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack.

stories.title: Jojo the gorilla has spent his life alone. Can he finally find a companion?
stories.body: Jojo was poached as an infant and grew up in captivity. His keepers want to find him a friend - but it's not straightforward.

stories.title: After a summer win, India's Gen Z protesters face a winter of uncertainty
stories.body: A new wave of youth dissent swept India this summer, fuelled by frustration and irreverent online satire.
